settings_ldap_wall_groups_help: Members of no other listed group become wall displays: they only see wall mode.
settings_saml_wall_groups_help: Comma-separated. Members of no administrator or operator group become wall displays: they only see wall mode.
settings_sso_wall_groups_help: Comma separated. Members who are neither admins nor operators become wall displays: they only see wall mode. Filled alone, this list only decides the wall display role.
settings_users_role_wall_help: For a screen on a wall: after signing in it goes straight to wall mode and cannot open any other page, setting or data. It stays signed in as long as it shows the wall; disable the account, reset its password or give it another role to sign it out.
settings_users_role_wall_option: Wall display — shows the wall only
wall_sign_out_title: This account is a wall display: signing out is the only way to leave the wall.
